status: Experimental pressure-only baseline, not the final reference surrogate
model: 6 control gates, 8 cylinders, powers [1,2], 1024 causal taps at 20000 Hz
limitations: Independent test waveform correlation is only 0.812; transients and high bands are not yet accurate.
No jet, mechanical, intake or turbo noise; no listener directivity stage.
Game engine remains at its original 10kHz/four fluid steps; training used 20kHz/twelve. The streaming adapter resamples but cannot recreate missing input bandwidth.
Reference boundary correction is still under validation. This model intentionally remains a provisional snapshot, not a validated physics replacement.
Training also used cycleVariation=0.1 and a flat 1.545bar boost target from the reference configuration; the game deliberately retains its original combustion scatter and boost map.
export: Coefficients rounded to 9 significant digits after f32 conversion, verified bit-identical to the runtime f32 coefficients.
